estimatedFields: the bay-door opening, the grapple, the move to the release position and the solar array deployment times (the report: grapple about 1 h after the arm was positioned, the move about 1 h after that; no clock times)
eva.met (about 18:00 UTC on 7 April, the English Wikipedia's STS-37 page; the report gives no start time) and eva.durationS (the report's 3 h 30 min; Wikipedia gives 4 h 32 min)
sepBurns (no separation burn after the release is in the report; one RCS burn a minute after it is drawn)
the arm's joint angles, how far Compton was lowered for the spacewalk and the antenna boom's stowed angle

provenance.l: NASA STS-37 Mission Report: launch 095:14:22:44.988 GMT; the GRO high-gain antenna would not deploy after GRO was raised on the RMS; RCS and RMS shaking failed; a 3 h 30 min contingency EVA, the RMS lowering GRO so the antenna was reachable from the bay; the antenna freed early in the EVA; release from the RMS 097:22:36:47 GMT
